sentences: I'd like to make a complaint about my order.
أود أن أقدّم شكوى بخصوص طلبي.
The washing machine was delivered yesterday, but it's faulty.
تم توصيل الغسالة أمس، لكنّ بها عطلًا.
My order still hasn't been sent, and I paid two weeks ago.
لم يُرسَل طلبي حتى الآن، وقد دفعت منذ أسبوعين.
Your complaint is being dealt with by our team.
يتم التعامل مع شكواك الآن من قِبَل فريقنا.
I was kept on hold for forty minutes!
جعلوني أنتظر على الخط أربعين دقيقة!
I'd like a refund or a replacement, please.
أريد استرداد المبلغ أو استبدال المنتج، من فضلك.
The problem will be sorted out within 48 hours.
ستُحَل المشكلة خلال ٤٨ ساعة.
I had my phone repaired, but it broke again a week later.
أصلحت هاتفي عند فني، لكنه تعطل مرة أخرى بعد أسبوع.
We're getting the kitchen painted next week.
سندهن المطبخ (عند نقّاش) الأسبوع القادم.
This is unacceptable. Can I speak to the manager, please?
هذا غير مقبول. هل يمكنني التحدث إلى المدير من فضلك؟

grammar.intro_en:
Passive = be (in the right tense) + past participle. We use it when the action is more important than the person who does it.
have / get + object + past participle = someone else does a job for you (you pay or ask them to do it).
grammar.intro_ar: يخلط المتعلم العربي بين «قصّيت شعري» بمعنى ذهبت إلى الحلاق، وبين أن يقص شعره بنفسه: جملة I cut my hair تعني أنك قصصته بيدك! إذا قام شخص آخر بالعمل لك فقل I had my hair cut أو I got my hair cut. وفي المبني للمجهول يظهر الزمن في فعل be وحده، والفعل الرئيسي يبقى في التصريف الثالث دائمًا: is being repaired (يتم الآن)، has been sent (تم)، will be delivered (سيتم). والخطأ الشائع هو حذف be كقولهم The order sent yesterday، والصحيح The order was sent yesterday.

rows: Complaints are answered within a day.
The tickets had been sold before we arrived.
will be / can be / must be + p.p.
The problem will be sorted out. It must be fixed today.
A mechanic serviced it for me.
She's getting her hair cut tomorrow.

notes: Use by + person only when it is important: The cake was made by my grandmother.
Wrong: I cut my hair at the barber's. ✔ I had (got) my hair cut at the barber's.
get something done is more informal than have something done.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 · Rewrite in the passive.
items: 1) They deliver the newspapers every morning.
2) Someone is repairing my laptop.
3) They sent the wrong size.
4) They have cancelled our flight.
5) They will refund the money next week.
6) They had sold all the tickets.
answers: 1) The newspapers are delivered every morning.
2) My laptop is being repaired.
3) The wrong size was sent.
4) Our flight has been cancelled.
5) The money will be refunded next week.
6) All the tickets had been sold.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 · Complete with the correct passive form.
exercises.instructions: Complete with the correct passive form.
items: 1) The lift ___ (repair) at the moment, so please use the stairs.
2) My complaint ___ (not answer) yet.
3) These phones ___ (make) in Korea.
4) The parcel ___ (deliver) tomorrow morning.
5) When we arrived, the food ___ (already / eat).
6) The faulty fridge must ___ (replace) immediately.
answers: 1) is being repaired
2) hasn't been answered
3) are made
4) will be delivered
5) had already been eaten
6) be replaced

exercises.title: Exercise 3 · Rewrite with have / get something done.
exercises.instructions: Rewrite with have / get something done. Use the words in brackets.
items: 1) A mechanic is checking my car. (I / have)
2) A technician repaired Mona's washing machine. (Mona / get)
3) The barber cuts my son's hair every month. (I / have)
4) A technician is going to install our new air conditioner tomorrow. (we / get)
5) A photographer took Nour's passport photos. (Nour / have)
6) The dry cleaner's has cleaned my suit. (I / have)
answers: 1) I'm having my car checked.
2) Mona got her washing machine repaired.
3) I have my son's hair cut every month.
4) We're going to get our new air conditioner installed tomorrow.
5) Nour had her passport photos taken.
6) I've had my suit cleaned. / I've had my suit dry-cleaned.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 · Translate into English.
items: 1) أُلغيت رحلتنا ولم يعتذر أحد.
2) يتم إصلاح سيارتي الآن.
3) قصصت شعري أمس عند الحلاق.
4) لم يُرسَل طلبي حتى الآن.
5) أريد استرداد المبلغ، فهذا المنتج معيب.
answers: 1) Our flight was cancelled and nobody apologised. / Our flight was cancelled and no one apologised.
2) My car is being repaired now. / My car is being fixed now.
3) I had (got) my hair cut at the barber's yesterday.
4) My order hasn't been sent yet.
5) I'd like a refund; this product is faulty. / I want my money back; this product is faulty.

write_speak: Write & Speak — Write a formal email of complaint (150–200 words) to an online shop. Say what you ordered, what went wrong and what you want them to do. Use at least four passive forms. Then role-play the phone call to customer service with a friend: be polite but firm.
other: Example: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about an order I placed on your website on 3rd March (reference number 58217). I ordered a microwave, and I was told that it would be delivered within three days. Unfortunately, the microwave was not delivered until 15th March, almost two weeks late. When the box was opened, I found that the door was damaged and the machine did not work at all. I called your customer service line three times, and each time I was kept on hold for more than thirty minutes. I was promised a call back, but nobody has contacted me since then. This is unacceptable, especially as the full amount has already been taken from my bank account. I would like the faulty microwave to be collected from my flat in Nasr City as soon as possible, and I would like a full refund. Alternatively, I would accept a replacement, provided that it is delivered this week. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Yours faithfully, Mona Adel
